activities.name: Manali–Leh highway and the Ladakh passes
activities.note: the only road approaches to Ladakh, and both cross passes above 5,000 m

windows.reason: shut under snow. The highway normally opens to civilian traffic in late May or early June — 27 May in 2025, 19 May in 2024 — and stays open until October
the opening and closing months; the exact date is announced each year rather than fixed
roads still open, crowds gone, and the clearest autumn light on the mountains

activities.name: Ladakh in the monsoon
activities.note: Ladakh sits in the Himalayan rain shadow, so the monsoon that soaks the rest of northern India mostly misses it

windows.reason: dry and open on the plateau while the plains are under monsoon — though landslides on the approach passes, south of the range, can still close the road
